title: Free Wheelin | KEY.co
meta_description: In the heart of Seacrest | Private deeded beach
description_expanded: Nestled in the vibrant heart of Seacrest Beach, Free Wheelin is a coastal haven designed for unforgettable family getaways. This beautifully updated, single-level retreat boasts all-new furnishings, fresh paint, and modern lighting, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere. The thoughtfully designed layout includes a King bedroom with an ensuite, a charming bunk room featuring a full bed and two twins with an adjoining bathroom, and a serene King Master suite at the end of the hall. The spacious living area, with its tasteful decor and open design, is the perfect gathering spot for making cherished memories. With its single-level design, Free Wheelin is ideal for families of all ages, offering comfort and convenience for every generation. Located along the iconic 30A, Seacrest Beach offers the quintessential Emerald Coast experience. Guests of Free Wheelin enjoy access to a private deeded beach just moments away and the largest resort-style pool in Northern Florida, a sparkling 12,000-square-foot oasis perfect for family fun. Beyond the community, the charm of 30A awaits, with its sugar-white sands, boutique shops, and mouthwatering seafood restaurants. Whether exploring neighboring Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach or savoring the laid-back vibes unique to Seacrest, Free Wheelin serves as the ultimate home base for your coastal adventure.
